verdict.rationale: Alma documents itself as an immigration law firm whose core service is attorney-led petition preparation. Every case has a dedicated attorney, case preparation runs about 2 weeks once evidence is collected, clients complete questionnaires and a strategy meeting, and RFE responses are included in a flat fee. That clearly delivers the core of end-to-end petition handling for founders. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of drafting expert/support recommendation letters, assembling the evidence binder, form preparation and the actual USCIS filing step, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration.
